$comment: One name means one thing across every typed, inline and native component. tests/Unit/ComponentParameterVocabularyTest.php checks every catalogue parameter against this file: a name is either in the vocabulary, or it is a justified exception for the components listed, and no component uses a known synonym of a vocabulary name.

vocabulary.type: Semantic status: what the content means (info, success, warning, danger).
vocabulary.variant: Visual style of the same content (filled, tonal, outlined, plain).
vocabulary.scheme: Colour from the SIMAI Framework palette.
vocabulary.size: A step of the SIMAI Framework size scale (1/3, 1/2, 1, 2, 3).
vocabulary.ratio: Aspect ratio, always written a/b; auto where the component allows it.
vocabulary.label: Accessible name, read by assistive technology; it need not be visible.
vocabulary.title: Visible heading or name.
vocabulary.caption: Visible caption under the content.
vocabulary.src: Address of a file the component reads or shows.
vocabulary.sync: Group of components that switch together.
vocabulary.tone: Tone of the surface or block: default, muted, accent, contrast.

lang.reason: Language of the shown source, the same word a Markdown fence uses; not a page locale.

lines.reason: Line range of the source file (N or N-M); no vocabulary name selects part of a file.

limit.reason: Maximum number of listed items; a count, not a size step.

engine.reason: Which renderer draws the source (mermaid); a technical choice, not a style.

format.reason: File format shown to the reader (ZIP, PDF); file metadata.

file_size.reason: File size text shown before downloading (4.8 MB); named apart from size, which is the Framework scale.

checksum.reason: Checksum text for verifying the file; file metadata.

action.reason: What the link does: download the file or open it; a behaviour, not a style or arrangement.

provider.reason: Who serves the material (embed: video, map, external) or, in the internal atlas index, which provider a catalogue entry comes from.

id.reason: A stable identifier: the embed's page anchor, or the stored project example to show. Neither is an address, so neither is href or src.

consent.reason: Whether the reader must agree before third-party content loads; a privacy rule.

preview.reason: How the example is shown: inline on the page or in an isolated frame.

fullscreen.reason: Whether the example offers a full-screen view; a behaviour switch.

wrap.reason: Whether long source lines wrap; the same switch as docara.json example settings.

fit.reason: How the image fills its ratio box (cover, contain), after CSS object-fit.

columns.reason: Number of grid columns on wide screens; a count.

gap.reason: Space between grid items on the Framework gap scale (0-4); spacing, not size.

padding.reason: Inner spacing on the Framework spacing scale; spacing, not size.

media.reason: What the hero image is: side media, background, none or auto.

background_image.reason: Background picture of the surface; one of the background_* group, kept apart from a future content src.

background_fit.reason: How the background picture fills the block; part of the background_* group.

background_x.reason: Horizontal anchor of the background picture; part of the background_* group.

background_y.reason: Vertical anchor of the background picture; part of the background_* group.

overlay.reason: Light or dark layer between the background picture and the text, for contrast.

effect.reason: Name of a SIMAI Framework background effect drawn behind the hero.

effect_theme.reason: Which colour theme the background effect follows.

effect_settings.reason: JSON settings passed to the background effect.

display.reason: Inline or block formula, the TeX term for the same choice.

side.reason: Which side the image takes beside the text. Kept until media, showcase and promo merge into one media block with a layout.

current.reason: Number of the current step; a position, not a style or arrangement.

width.reason: Whether the surface spans the content column or the full window.

content_width.reason: Width of the content inside the surface.

interactive.reason: Whether the reader can fold and unfold branches; a behaviour switch.

icon.reason: Material Symbols name of a decorative icon. Proposed for the vocabulary: cards, tabs and callouts will take the same name.

family.reason: Glyph family of the icon font (outlined, rounded, sharp).

weight.reason: Stroke weight of the icon font.

filled.reason: Whether the glyph is drawn filled; an axis of the icon font.

container.reason: Shape drawn around the icon (none, square, circle).

author.reason: Who said or wrote the quoted text; citation data.

source.reason: Name of the publication the quote comes from; citation data, not a file address.

kind.reason: Internal build view: filters catalogue entries by their kind field, so the filter keeps the field's name.

authoring.reason: Internal build view: filters catalogue entries by their authoring field.

support.reason: Internal build view: filters catalogue entries by their support field.

status.reason: Internal build view: filters catalogue entries by their status field.

namespace.reason: Internal build view: filters catalogue entries by their namespace field.

owner.reason: Internal build view: filters catalogue entries by their owner field.

origin.reason: Internal build view: filters catalogue entries by their origin field.

ids.reason: Internal build view: an explicit list of catalogue entry IDs.

schema.reason: Internal build view: which Docara schema the field table describes.

scope.reason: Internal build view: which part of the schema the field table covers.

fields.reason: Internal build view: the field names to list.

meaning_exceptions.internal_preview.size: Internal build view, not a public component: its frame height (compact, normal, tall) predates the vocabulary. Its only callers are the composition guide pages; it moves to height with them.
meaning_exceptions.internal_preview.title: Internal build view, not a public component: the text is the iframe's accessible name, so it would be label; it moves with internal_preview.size.
